skill.name: Area Chart Generator Configuration
skill.description: Configure and generate area chart shapes by setting baseline/topline accessors, curve interpolation, and rendering context. Use when building area or radial area visualizations from tabular data.
skill.skill_body:
Chain accessor methods on a d3.area or d3.areaRadial generator to map data fields to coordinates and apply rendering settings. Set x0/x1 (or startAngle/endAngle for radial), y0/y1 (or innerRadius/outerRadius for radial), curve interpolator, and rendering context. Call the configured generator with a dataset to produce SVG path data or canvas output.

## Objective

Generate area geometry for charting
## Applicable Signals

- Dataset with numeric x and y dimensions
- Requirement for baseline and topline definition
- Need for curve interpolation (linear, cardinal, monotone, etc.)

## Contraindications

- Rendering line charts, scatter plots, or non-area geometries
- Data is already pre-rendered or geometry is fixed
- No baseline/topline distinction required

## Workflow Steps

- Create a new area generator using d3.area() or d3.areaRadial()
- Chain accessor methods: set x0, x1 (or startAngle, endAngle for radial) to define baseline
- Chain accessor methods: set y0, y1 (or innerRadius, outerRadius for radial) to define topline
- Set curve interpolator using .curve() method
- Set rendering context using .context() if canvas rendering is needed
- Call the configured generator with dataset to produce path data or render

## Constraints

- Data must be array-like with consistent field structure
- Accessor functions must return numeric values for coordinates
- Curve type must be a valid d3 curve factory

## Cautions

- Ensure accessor functions handle undefined or missing data gracefully
- Verify curve type is compatible with area geometry (not all curves suit areas)
- Context setting is required for canvas rendering; omit for SVG path output

## Output Contract

- Configured area generator object that accepts a dataset and produces SVG path data (string) or canvas rendering; generator is reusable across multiple datasets with the same structure
